name: opp115_user_choice_control_legal_bench
description: A legal-domain benchmark focused on user choice and control scenarios: it evaluates model performance on tasks related to legal text interpretation, decision options, or control-question answering in a legal context. The suite tests models' ability to classify or select appropriate user-choice options given legal prompts or documents, emphasizing precision and adherence to legal constraints. It is intended for assessing models used in legal-assistance or policy-compliance settings.
reputation: A specialized, domain-specific benchmark used in legal/NLP evaluations with limited but growing adoption.
